indexes.name: atlas_symbol_versions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atlas_symbol_versions_pkey ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (symbol_version_id)

indexes.name: atlas_symbol_versions_stable_symbol_id_source_revision_decl_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atlas_symbol_versions_stable_symbol_id_source_revision_decl_key ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (stable_symbol_id, source_revision, declaration_hash, upstream_node_id)

indexes.name: idx_atlas_symbol_versions_packet_ordinal
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_symbol_versions_packet_ordinal ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (packet_key, candidate_ordinal) WHERE (packet_key IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_atlas_symbol_versions_source
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_symbol_versions_source ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (source_ref, source_revision)

indexes.name: idx_atlas_symbol_versions_symbol_revision
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_symbol_versions_symbol_revision ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (stable_symbol_id, source_revision)

indexes.name: idx_atlas_symbol_versions_upstream_node
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_symbol_versions_upstream_node ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (upstream_node_id)

indexes.name: idx_atlas_symbol_versions_upstream_symbol
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_atlas_symbol_versions_upstream_symbol ON public.atlas_symbol_versions USING btree (upstream_symbol_id) WHERE (upstream_symbol_id IS NOT NULL)

observedQueries: source_ref = $1 AND source_revision = $2 (existing idx_atlas_symbol_versions_source covers this)

proposal.preferredShape: Do not add an index solely because the table contract names a field; select a composite or standalone index only after resolver call-site census and EXPLAIN on production-shaped predicates.

candidates.name: atlas_symbol_versions_source_revision_idx
candidates.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY atlas_symbol_versions_source_revision_idx ON public.atlas_symbol_versions (source_revision);
candidates.useWhen: Independent revision-only filtering is a real hot query.

candidates.name: atlas_symbol_versions_qualified_name_idx
candidates.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY atlas_symbol_versions_qualified_name_idx ON public.atlas_symbol_versions (qualified_name);
candidates.useWhen: Independent exact qualified-name lookup is a real hot query.

candidates.name: atlas_symbol_versions_source_revision_qualified_name_idx
candidates.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY atlas_symbol_versions_source_revision_qualified_name_idx ON public.atlas_symbol_versions (source_revision, qualified_name);
candidates.useWhen: The dominant resolver predicate constrains both columns in this order.

excluded: No pg_trgm index proposed: fuzzy qualified-name search is not yet proven as a resolver requirement.
No partial index excluding workspace:0: legacy values must be filtered by authority predicates, never hidden or coerced by index design.
No pgvector index: the existing semantic_768 HNSW owner is separate and already present.
